description: Computes 1-based coordinate expectations from per-joint spatial softmax heatmaps, then applies coordinate L1 regression (Sun et al., §2 Eqs. (2)-(4), §3; paper.txt:77-121, 196; upstream reference helper pytorch_projects/common_pytorch/common_loss/weighted_mse.py:241-252).

examples.title: Train a heatmap predictor with integral regression

name: Integral regression loss

parameters.additional parameters: No additional parameters are supported; unsupported keys passed through **params raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because ignored-keypoint semantics are unspecified
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point heatmap logits shaped [B,K,H,W] or [B,K,D,H,W] with positive dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns coordinate errors shaped [B,K,2] or [B,K,3], mean averages all coordinate errors, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite floating-point coordinates shaped [B,K,2] for 2D or [B,K,3] for 3D, in (x,y) or (x,y,z) order on the same dtype and device
